grammar_focus: must 的用法(主考:must 表不可逃避的义务 = have to / have got to 三者可互换 · 跟 will 用 have to · must 无过去式,过去用 had to · must 表推测'一定是'must be)+ as 的多义与 in spite of(辅考:as = 因为/当…时/作为 · in spite of + 名词表'尽管')
scene: 姑姑詹妮弗是位演员,至少三十五岁却总在台上扮演小姑娘——演出时必须穿鲜红连衣裙和黑长筒袜,去年还不得不穿短袜;被问年龄时她只笑答'长大成人一定很可怕'

grammar_card.title: 说"必须/不得不"(must 和 have to)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"必须做某事"——must 和 have to。注意:两者意思相近、常可互换;但 must 没有过去式,过去的"必须"要用 had to;must 还能表示"一定是"(推测)。全用本课句子举例。

rows: must 表"不可逃避的必须",= have to / have got to
She must appear in a red dress. = She has to appear…
跟 will 说将来的"必须":用 have to,不用 must
Jennifer will have to take part in a new play.
must 没有过去式,过去的"必须"用 had to
Last year she had to wear short socks.
must 还能表"一定是"(有把握的推测)
She must be at least thirty-five years old.

specialRules.rule: 问句里问"必须吗"常用 have to:Must you go? = Do you have to go?
as 有多种含义:因为(as I am busy)/当…时(as I was leaving)/作为(as an engineer)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
options: Because she thinks it must be terrible to be grown up
Because she has forgotten her real age

passage: My aunt Jennifer is an actress. She must be at least thirty-five years old. In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl. Every evening she goes to the theater and becomes someone new. Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon. This time, she will play a girl of seventeen. In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings. Last year, in another play, she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-colored dress. Jennifer never tells anyone her real age. If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always laughs and answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'

grammar_points.name: must 表义务——不可逃避的"必须"
must = have to / have got to(义务可互换)
跟 will 或问句——用 have to 代替 must
must 无过去式——过去的"必须"用 had to
must 表推测——"一定是"must be
must / have to 综合运用
as 的多义(辅考:因为 / 当…时 / 作为)
in spite of + 名词——"尽管"(辅考)
